name: Pnp_debugStartRally
note: RPPnpBall::mHitCount starts at 2x this value; never set

name: Pnp_cpuSwingHintShown
note: RPPnpPlayer::Calculate shows a hint once; cleared by Reset

name: Pnp_rallyLimitMode
note: 0: limit by saved medal, 1: 100, 2: 999 (RPPnpGame::Reset); never set

name: Pnp_rallyLimit
note: 100 or 999; caps the rally counter and the result

name: Pnp_maxOfficialMii
note: 6; official-database Miis used for the audience

name: Pnp_resultCameraValue
note: -1350; camera +0xE4 target in the result phase

name: Pnp_cameraOffsetNear
note: -15; camera target Z/X offset for the default court side (RPPnpGame::Reset)

name: Pnp_ballTrailSoundTable
note: sound IDs picked by the ball sound actor's emitter-rate update (Pnp_BallTrail_updateEmitterRate)

name: Pnp_SceneSound_vtable

name: Pnp_BallTrail_vtable
